terms.gloss: there are ups and downs, sometimes this way, sometimes that
terms.comment: A countryman’s saying in Petronius: “now so, now so”.

phrases.latin: ‘modo sīc, modo sīc’, inquit rūsticus: varium porcum perdiderat
phrases.english: “Sometimes this way, sometimes that,” said the countryman: he had lost a spotted pig

phrases.latin: Eī modo bene, modo male est.
phrases.english: He has his ups and downs.

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 110.
